FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

US federal waters and national parks fishing licence

Atlantic HMS trips require the appropriate vessel permit for tunas, billfish, swordfish, and sharks. National parks apply park-specific rules; Yellowstone needs its own permit instead of a state fishing licence.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Vessels that fish for covered Atlantic HMS species.
  • Yellowstone anglers aged 16 or older.

Who doesn’t

  • Yellowstone children aged 15 or younger may fish under a permitted adult's direct supervision or obtain a free signed child permit.

Licence options and prices

Atlantic HMS Angling vessel permitanyAnnual renewal$24 USD
Yellowstone 3-day permitany3 days$40 USD

Yellowstone season permitanyThrough December 31, 2026$75 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • HMS shark endorsement
    Required to fish for sharks under an HMS Angling or Charter/Headboat permit; training and a quiz apply.

Saltwater

Atlantic HMS permits concern the Atlantic, Gulf, and Caribbean management area. Check other federal fisheries and state landing requirements separately.

Fishing with a guide or charter

For-hire HMS trips use the vessel's HMS Charter/Headboat permit. Check each state's client licence rules and each park's permit rules.

Rules visitors should know

  • HMS permits attach to the vessel and require annual renewal.
  • HMS Angling vessels cannot sell their catch.
  • Yellowstone prohibits felt-soled fishing footwear.
  • Yellowstone requires barbless hooks and lead-free artificial lures or flies.
  • Park closures and special rules can override otherwise applicable state rules.

How to buy

Buy HMS permits through NOAA's permit portal. Buy Yellowstone permits through Recreation.gov or local permit sellers.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in US federal waters and national parks?

Atlantic HMS trips require the appropriate vessel permit for tunas, billfish, swordfish, and sharks. National parks apply park-specific rules; Yellowstone needs its own permit instead of a state fishing licence.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in US federal waters and national parks?

Atlantic HMS Angling vessel permit: $24 USD; Yellowstone 3-day permit: $40 USD; Yellowstone 7-day permit: $55 USD; Yellowstone season permit: $75 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in US federal waters and national parks?

Buy HMS permits through NOAA's permit portal. Buy Yellowstone permits through Recreation.gov or local permit sellers.
